headline: Approved MSBA delegate, staff nominations, extra-duty assignments, donations, and two revised policies 6-0
summary: The committee approved the 26-27 MSBA local delegate and alternate, administrator and teacher nominations, extra-duty assignments, August 12, 2026 meeting minutes, donations to several schools, and second readings of two revised policies. Members also received updates on district operations, a UTC Sub Committee report, and reviewed important dates.
decisions: Approved Sara Luciano as the 26-27 MSBA local delegate, 6-0.
Approved Katie Brydon as the 26-27 MSBA alternate, 6-0.
Approved the draft Minutes of the August 12, 2026 Regular School Committee Meeting, 6-0.
Approved the administrator nomination of Paul Butler as Assistant Superintendent, Central Office, 6-0.
Approved teacher nominations for the 2026-2027 school year with one-year probationary contracts, 6-0.
Approved extra-duty assignments for the 2026-2027 School Year, 6-0.

Approved donations shared by Committee Member Shelly Okere, including $4,625 to Abraham Lincoln School, $200 to 14th Street School, $240 to Vine Street School, $500 to William S. Cohen School, and $3,600 to Cameron Stadium, 6-0.
Approved Second Reading of Revised Policy IHBAC and Revised Policy JLF, 6-0.
